caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a rectangular, upholstered backrest and seat, both covered in brown leather or fabric. The chair features intricately carved, twisted wooden elements on its arm supports and front legs, as well as a twisted stretcher that runs horizontally between the front legs. The arms of the chair are curved outward at the ends, and the front legs are square with carved feet. The color palette primarily consists of shades of brown, with the wood and upholstery both rendered in similar tones. The chair is centered in the composition, set against a plain, light beige background, with a faint rectangular line framing the object. There are no additional objects or background details present in the drawing.
title: Armchair
